title: A Saudi, an Indian and an Iranian walk into a Qatari bar ...
speaker: Maz Jobrani

sentences.en: Translator: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast Hello, Doha. Hello!
sentences.zh: 翻译人员: Xiaoma Cheng 校对人员: Jacy Su

sentences.en: Salaam alaikum. I love coming to Doha. It's such an international place.
sentences.zh: 嗨，多哈。嗨，大家好（阿拉伯问候语） 我喜欢来多哈。这是个如此国际化的地方。

sentences.en: It feels like the United Nations here. You land at the airport, and you're welcomed by an Indian lady who takes you to Al Maha Services, where you meet a Filipino lady who hands you off to a South African lady
sentences.zh: 这就像----似乎联合国就在这里。 她把你带到阿玛哈酒店，在这里你见到一位菲律宾女士

sentences.en: who then takes you to a Korean who takes you to a Pakistani guy with the luggage who takes you to the car with a Sri Lankan.
sentences.zh: 南非女士把你带给一位韩国人，而这位韩国人把你和行李带 给一个巴基斯坦家伙。 巴基斯坦人连同一个斯里兰卡人把你带上了车

sentences.en: You go to the hotel and you check in. There's a Lebanese.
sentences.zh: 你到达了酒店并办理了入住。（前台）是个黎巴嫩人。

sentences.en: Yeah? And then a Swedish guy showed me my room.
sentences.zh: 额？然后一个瑞典人带我看了下房间。

sentences.en: I said, "Where are the Qataris?" (Laughter) (Applause) They said, "No, no, it's too hot. They come out later. They're smart."
sentences.zh: 我说“卡塔尔人呢？”（笑声） （掌声） 他们说“不，不，现在太热了，他们晚点出来，他们比较聪明”

sentences.en: "They know." (Laughter) And of course, it's growing so fast, sometimes there's growing pains.
sentences.zh: （笑声）“他们知道这一点” 当然多哈发展如此迅速，有时也有成长的烦恼

sentences.en: You know, like sometimes you run into people that you think know the city well, but they don't know it that well.
sentences.zh: 你们知道，比如，你对这个城市很了解 但有时你会遇到一些对这个城市不是很了解的人

sentences.en: My Indian cab driver showed up at the W, and I asked him to take me to the Sheraton, and he said, "No problem, sir."
sentences.zh: 我的印度司机出现在W 我让他送我去希尔顿酒店 他说“没问题，先生”

sentences.en: And then we sat there for two minutes. I said, "What's wrong?" He said, "One problem, sir."
sentences.zh: 然后我们就在原地呆了2分钟 我说“怎么不走？”他说“有个问题，先生”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "What?" He goes, "Where is it?"
sentences.zh: 我说“怎么不走？”他说“有个问题，先生” 我说“什么问题”。他说“那地方在哪？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I go, "You're the driver, you should know."
sentences.zh: （笑声） 我继续说“你是司机，你应该知道”。他说“我不知道，我刚到不久，先生”

sentences.en: He goes, "No, I just arrived, sir." I go, "You just arrived at the W?" "No, I just arrived in Doha, sir."
sentences.zh: 我继续说“你是司机，你应该知道”。他说“我不知道，我刚到不久，先生” 我说“你刚到W吗？”（他说）“不，我刚到多哈，先生。

sentences.en: (Laughter) "I was on my way home from the airport, I got a job. I'm working already."
sentences.zh: 我从机场回家的路上，得到了这份工作 我已经在工作了“

sentences.en: (Laughter) He goes, "Sir, why don't you drive?"
sentences.zh: 我已经在工作了“ 他说“先生，你干嘛不开车呢？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "I don't know where we're going."
sentences.zh: 他说“先生，你干嘛不开车呢？” 我说“我不知道我们要去哪”

sentences.en: "Neither do I. It will be an adventure, sir."
sentences.zh: “我也不知道，这将是个探险之旅，先生”

sentences.en: (Laughter) The Middle East has been an adventure the past couple of years.
sentences.zh: “我也不知道，这将是个探险之旅，先生” 这确实是场探险之旅。中东在过去数年一直在探险。

sentences.en: It is going crazy with the Arab Spring and revolution and all this.
sentences.zh: 中东因为阿拉伯之春运动，改革和所有这些事情 而变得疯狂。这里今晚有黎巴嫩人吗？

sentences.en: Are there any Lebanese here tonight, by applause?
sentences.zh: 而变得疯狂。这里今晚有黎巴嫩人吗？ 黎巴嫩人请鼓掌下。（鼓掌）。黎巴嫩人。

sentences.en: (Cheering) Lebanese, yeah. The Middle East is going crazy.
sentences.zh: 黎巴嫩人请鼓掌下。（鼓掌）。黎巴嫩人。 是的，中东正在变得疯狂。

sentences.en: You know the Middle East is going crazy when Lebanon is the most peaceful place in the region.
sentences.zh: 你们知道中东正在变得疯狂。 而黎巴嫩是这个地区最安静的地方。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) Who would have thought?
sentences.zh: （笑声）（鼓掌） 谁曾想到过呢？哦，我的天啊。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Oh my gosh. No, there's serious issues in the region.
sentences.zh: 谁曾想到过呢？哦，我的天啊。 不。这个地区有着很严重的问题。

sentences.en: Some people don't want to talk about them. I'm here to talk about them tonight.
sentences.zh: 一些人不愿意谈论这些。我今晚就要在这谈下他们。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen of the Middle East, here's a serious issue.
sentences.zh: 中东的女士们先生们。 有一个很严肃的问题。当我们见面时，

sentences.en: When we see each other, when we say hello, how many kisses are we going to do?
sentences.zh: 当我们说你好时，我们要轻吻几下呢？

sentences.en: (Laughter) Every country is different and it's confusing, okay?
sentences.zh: 当我们说你好时，我们要轻吻几下呢？ 每个国家都不一样，这很困惑人，不是吗？

sentences.en: In Lebanon, they do three. In Egypt, they do two.
sentences.zh: 在黎巴嫩，他们亲3下。在埃及，他们亲2下。

sentences.en: I was in Lebanon, I got used to three. I went to Egypt. I went to say hello to this one Egyptian guy, I went, one, two. I went for three -- He wasn't into it.
sentences.zh: 我在黎巴嫩时，我习惯了亲3下。 当我去埃及后，我去和一个埃及人问好。 我去了，（亲了）一下，两下。当我要亲第三下时，他退回去了

sentences.en: (Laughter) I told him, I said, "No, no, I was just in Lebanon."
sentences.zh: （笑声） 我告诉他，我说”不好意思，我刚从黎巴嫩过来“

sentences.en: He goes, "I don't care where you were. You just stay where you are, please."
sentences.zh: 他说”我不介意你从哪过来。你就用你们的习惯好了。就用你们的习惯“

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) I went to Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 他说”我不介意你从哪过来。你就用你们的习惯好了。就用你们的习惯“ 我去了沙特阿拉伯。在沙特阿拉伯，他们亲1下，2下。

sentences.en: In Saudi Arabia, they go one, two, and then they stay on the same side: three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 -- (Laughter) Next time you see a Saudi, look closely.
They're just a little bit tilted. (Laughter) "Abdul, are you okay?"
sentences.zh: 下次你看到沙特人，近点看。他们只是有一点倾斜。 ”阿卜杜勒，你还好吗？“ ”额，我只是半小时一直在问好“

sentences.en: "I was saying hello for half an hour. I'll be all right."
sentences.zh: ”阿卜杜勒，你还好吗？“ ”额，我只是半小时一直在问好“ ”我会好的“

sentences.en: (Laughter) Qataris, you guys do the nose to nose.
sentences.zh: ”我会好的“ 卡塔尔人，你们用鼻子和鼻子来问好

sentences.en: Why is that? Are you too tired to go all the way around?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？你们是太累了而不愿两边动吗？

sentences.en: (Laughter) "Habibi, it's so hot. Just come here for a second. Say hello.
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？你们是太累了而不愿两边动吗？ "Habibi,这里太热了,过来下，（和你）问好。

sentences.en: Hello, Habibi. Just don't move. Just stay there, please.
sentences.zh: Habibi，Habibi，别动。请就保持这样的姿势。

sentences.en: I need to rest." (Laughter) Iranians, sometimes we do two, sometimes we do three.
sentences.zh: 我需要休息“ 每个国家----伊朗人，有时候亲2下，有时候3下

sentences.en: A friend of mine explained to me, before the '79 revolution, it was two.
sentences.zh: 我的一个朋友这么像我解释，在79改革前， 是2下。在改革后，变成了3下

sentences.en: (Laughter) After the revolution, three. So with Iranians, you can tell whose side the person is on based on the number of kisses they give you.
sentences.zh: 是2下。在改革后，变成了3下 所以对于伊朗人，你可以更具他们的轻吻次数 辨别他们是支持哪一方的。

sentences.en: Yeah, if you go one, two, three -- "I can't believe you support this regime!"
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你亲了一下，两下，三下。。。”我无法相信你是支持这个政体的

sentences.en: (Laughter) "With your three kisses." (Laughter) But no, guys, really, it is exciting to be here, and like I said, you guys are doing a lot culturally, you know, and it's amazing,
sentences.zh: 因为你亲了3下。” 言归正传，朋友们，很激动能站在这里， 就像我说的，你们在做着很多关于文化的东西，

sentences.en: and it helps change the image of the Middle East in the West.
sentences.zh: 你们知道，这是很神奇的事情，它有助于改变 西方人眼中的中东形象。就像许多美国人

sentences.en: A lot of Americans don't know a lot about us, about the Middle East.
sentences.zh: 不是很了解我们，不是很了解中东。

sentences.en: I'm Iranian and American. I'm there. I know, I've traveled here.
sentences.zh: 我是个伊朗人，也是个美国人。我住在美国，然后我知道，我是来这里旅游的。

sentences.en: There's so much, we laugh, right? People don't know we laugh.
sentences.zh: 这种（缺乏了解的）事情太多了，我们会笑，对吗？ 当我做邪恶坐标轴喜剧巡演的时候，（我发现）人们不知道我们会笑，

sentences.en: When I did the Axis of Evil comedy tour, it came out on Comedy Central, I went online to see what people were saying.
sentences.zh: 当我做邪恶坐标轴喜剧巡演的时候，（我发现）人们不知道我们会笑， 这部喜剧在喜剧中心（美国一个频道）出版，我上网 去看看网友们的评价，我进了一个保守派网友。

sentences.en: I ended up on a conservative website. One guy wrote another guy. He said, "I never knew these people laughed."
sentences.zh: 去看看网友们的评价，我进了一个保守派网友。 一个网友对另一个网友写道“我从不知道这些人还会笑。”

sentences.en: Think about it. You never see us laughing in American film or television, right?
sentences.zh: 想一下。在美国电影很电视剧中，你们从没见过我们中东人在里面笑，对吗？

sentences.en: Maybe like an evil laugh: "Wuhahaha." (Laughter) "I will kill you in the name of Allah, wuhahahahaha."
sentences.zh: 可能更多的是像个魔鬼，就像“Whahahaha，Wuhahaha 我要以真主阿拉的名义杀死你，Wuhahahaha”

sentences.en: (Laughter) But never like, "Ha ha la."
sentences.zh: 但从没有像“哈哈哈哈哈哈”

sentences.en: (Laughter) We like to laugh. We like to celebrate life.
sentences.zh: 但从没有像“哈哈哈哈哈哈” 我们喜欢笑，我们喜欢歌颂生命。

sentences.en: And I wish more Americans would travel here.
sentences.zh: 我希望更多的美国人来这里旅游。我经常鼓励我的朋友：

sentences.en: I always encourage my friends: "Travel, see the Middle East, there's so much to see, so many good people."
sentences.zh: 去那里旅行吧，看下中东，那里有很多值得看的东西，还有可爱的人民。 反过来也一样，它有助于阻止因误会以及

sentences.en: And it's vice versa, and it helps stop problems of misunderstanding and stereotypes from happening.
sentences.zh: 反过来也一样，它有助于阻止因误会以及 陈旧观念产生的问题。

sentences.en: For example, I don't know if you heard about this, a little while ago in the US, there was a Muslim family walking down the aisle of an airplane, talking about the safest place to sit on the plane.
sentences.zh: 不久前，在美国，有个穆斯林家庭 正走下飞机的通道， 谈论着飞机上最安全的位置。

sentences.en: Some passengers overheard them, somehow misconstrued that as terrorist talk, got them kicked off the plane.
sentences.zh: 一些在他们上方的乘客，不知为何，将这误解为 恐怖分子的谈话，把他们踢下了飞机。

sentences.en: It was a family, a mother, father, child, talking about the seating.
sentences.zh: 这是一家人，妈妈，爸爸，孩子，在从通道走下来 在谈论座位的问题。现在作为一个中东男性，

sentences.en: As a Middle Eastern male, I know there's certain things I'm not supposed to say on an airplane in the US, right?
sentences.zh: 在谈论座位的问题。现在作为一个中东男性， 我知道有一些事情不应该在美国的航班上讨论 对吧？

sentences.en: I'm not supposed to be walking down the aisle, and be like, "Hi, Jack." That's not cool.
sentences.zh: 当我走下通道时 我似乎不应该说，”嗨，杰克“，”因为这并不酷

sentences.en: (Laughter) Even if I'm there with my friend named Jack, I say, "Greetings, Jack. Salutations, Jack."
sentences.zh: 我似乎不应该说，”嗨，杰克“，”因为这并不酷 即使我在这里，我称呼我的名叫Jack的朋友，我说 "你好，杰克，你好，杰克"

sentences.en: Never "Hi, Jack." (Laughter) But now, apparently we can't even talk about the safest place to sit on an airplane.
sentences.zh: （大笑） 但是现在很明显我们甚至不能谈论 飞机上最安全的座位。

sentences.en: So my advice to all my Middle Eastern friends and Muslim friends and anyone who looks Middle Eastern or Muslim, so to, you know, Indians, and Latinos, everyone, if you're brown -- (Laughter) Here's my advice to my brown friends.
sentences.zh: 例如，印度人，拉丁人 每个棕色皮肤的人

sentences.en: (Laughter) The next time you're on an airplane in the US, just speak your mother tongue.
sentences.zh: 这是我给我棕色皮肤朋友们的建议 下一次你再在美国乘坐飞机， 就讲母语好了。

sentences.en: That way no one knows what you're saying. Life goes on.
sentences.zh: 这样的话，没人知道你在说什么。该怎么样就怎么样。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Granted, some mother tongues might sound a little threatening to the average American.
sentences.zh: 但是，一些母语对于一般的美国人 听上去会觉得有些恐怖，不是吗？

sentences.en: If you're walking down the aisle speaking Arabic, you might freak them out -- (Imitating Arabic) They might say, "What's he talking about?"
sentences.zh: 你可能会吓坏他们，如果你一边走着，一边”巴拉巴拉巴拉“。 他们会说”你们在谈论什么？“

sentences.en: The key, to my Arab brothers and sisters, is to throw in random good words to put people at ease as you're walking down the aisle.
sentences.zh: 所以（我给予）我阿拉伯兄弟姐妹们的解决方法就是 当你走下通道时，你就随便胡乱说点好词 来让别人放轻松。

sentences.en: Just as you're walking down -- (Imitating Arabic) Strawberry!
sentences.zh: 就像你走下来时”巴拉巴拉巴拉（阿拉伯语）“ 草莓！”

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Imitating Arabic) Rainbow! (Laughter) (Imitating Arabic)
sentences.zh: （大笑） ”巴拉巴拉巴拉（阿拉伯语）“--彩虹！“

sentences.en: Tutti Frutti! (Laughter) "I think he's going to hijack the plane with some ice cream."
sentences.zh: ”巴拉巴拉巴拉（阿拉伯语）--水果冰淇淋” “我想他大概想劫持一架装满冰淇淋的飞机”

sentences.en: Thank you very much. Have a good night. Thank you, TED.
sentences.zh: 非常谢谢你们。愿你们有个美好的夜晚。 谢谢，TED。（欢呼）（鼓掌）

sentences.en: (Cheers) (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢，TED。（欢呼）（鼓掌）
